title: Demo 1: Recruiter outreach
message:
Hi Alex,

I'm Jordan Lee from Nimbus AI. We are hiring a Founding AI Engineer in Toronto and your background in LangGraph and product engineering stood out. If you are open to exploring the role, I would love to share more details and talk about the team this week.

Best,
Jordan Lee
Senior Recruiter
jordan.lee@nimbusai.com

title: Demo 2: Interview scheduling with gaps
message:
Hello Alex,

Thanks for moving forward in our process. We'd like to schedule your next interview sometime next week with one of our engineering managers. Please send over your availability and we'll confirm the details.

Regards,
Priya

title: Demo 3: Compensation and sponsorship review
message:
Hi Alex,

We are excited about your profile for the Senior ML Engineer opportunity at Atlas Commerce. Before we move ahead, can you confirm whether you require visa sponsorship and share your compensation expectations for a base salary range of $170,000-$190,000?

Thanks,
Megan Ortiz
megan@atlascommerce.com

title: Coding assessment with deadline
message:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for applying to Quanta Labs. We'd like you to complete the attached take-home assessment by March 14 at 5 PM ET. Please reply if you have any clarifying questions.

Best,

Quanta Labs

message:

title: Networking reply
message:

title: Rejection email
message:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your time throughout the interview process. After careful consideration, we've decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with the role.

We appreciate your interest in Northgate.

Sincerely,
The Northgate Recruiting Team

title: Recruiter follow-up
message:
